title: ML in Production Course Homework
summary: A homework repository for an 'ML in production' course, containing an Airflow-based ML pipeline with a data-generation container that produces synthetic tabular data from the breast cancer dataset. Its generate.py script imports SDV's GaussianCopula synthesizer from sdv.tabular to create synthetic training data for the pipeline.
needs: No explicit .fit()/.sample() call visible in the provided evidence, only the import; usage inferred from the script's purpose as a data-generation component.
